in_marathi.name: Jehika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jehika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jehika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jaya' meaning victory and 'Ka' meaning wealth. This name is associated with the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity.
